name: DaxLib.SVG.Def.Rect

parameters.name: defId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the rectangle

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the rectangle (pixels or percentage)

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the rectangle (pixels or percentage)

parameters.name: rx
parameters.description: Optional: x radius for rounded corners

parameters.name: ry
parameters.description: Optional: y radius for rounded corners

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional: Direct SVG attributes to apply (e.g., "fill='none' stroke='blue'"), can generate with `DaxLib.SVG.Attr.*` or manually

parameters.name: transforms
parameters.description: Optional: Transformation to apply (can be generated with `DaxLib.SVG.Transforms`)

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Def.Rect' =
		(
			defId: STRING,
			width: STRING,
			height: STRING,
			rx: STRING,
			ry: STRING,
			attributes: STRING,
			transforms: STRING
		) =>

			"<rect id='" & defId & "'" &
			" width='" & width & "'" &
			" height='" & height & "'" &
			IF(NOT ISBLANK( rx ), " rx='" & rx & "'" ) & 
			IF(NOT ISBLANK( ry ), " ry='" & ry & "'" ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( attributes ), " " & attributes & " " ) &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( transforms ), " transform='" & transforms & "'" ) &
			"/>"
